founder_message: AfriCloud Institute is an NGO, not a paywall. If a young person has the fire to learn, tuition should not be the reason they never start.
We find them. We fund them. We mentor them in Cloud, DevOps, AI, Cybersecurity, and the crafts teams actually hire for, until they are job-ready, and until some of them are ready to found.
That is how communities rise: one scholar who gets in, does the work, and holds the door for the next.
Come as a scholar. Come as a partner. Come as a mentor. Help us raise African talent in the open.
whatsapp_panel_text: Admitted scholars meet here for class links, reminders, and the kind of peer pressure that builds careers.
